mechanism: The mid-August pulse to ~15.2 broke a channel at the crest (death on 08-11 with a URF=0.000 reading and S_UF sagging to ~0.68, two ignitions the next day), and that stored tension was fully distributed over the following four sessions, returning price to its pre-pulse shelf near 13. The damage is now old: S_UF has re-knit to ~0.82, URF sits mid-band and climbing (0.38 to 0.54 across the final three sessions), with zero further deaths and stable F_n ~2.3. Displacement stays mildly negative (D- unanimous the last two sessions) but is being absorbed without price making new lows -- a re-knitting field over a flat floor, not live collapse.
